basic_info.description: Welcome to 38 Harper Street! Nestled on one of Glen Park's most coveted streets, this gorgeous home offers an enchanting indoor-outdoor living experience on the cusp of Noe Valley. Top floor & light-filled, this home features a versatile three bedroom floor plan. The primary bedroom affords ample room for a king-size bed, while the second bedroom provides an ideal room for visiting family or friends. A third bedroom can also function as a home office or den. The fabulous chef's kitchen, with its new quartz countertops, cabinetry, gas range & farmhouse sink provides the perfect setting to hone your culinary skills. A full tiled bathroom off the hallway has also been updated with a new vanity, mirror & flooring. Step outside to enjoy your own private deck, overlooking the shared rear garden with its delightful patio that beckons on sunny days. Be sure to look for Billy Goat Hill and other local landmarks on the hills above. This handsome 2-unit Edwardian is close to the Noe Valley Rec Center, 30th and Church Streets dining, cafes and shopping, as well as convenient access to the J-Church MUNI and tech shuttles. Glen Park village & BART are a short stroll away along the picturesque tree-lined streets of the neighborhood. Welcome home to a new day at 38 Harper Street.
